name: Kharanos
summary: Travelers leaving Coldridge Valley make Kharanos their primary stop, just down the road from Ironforge. The town has a forge, gnomish workshops, and the famous Thunderbrew Distillery.

sections.title: A Hearty Frontier Haven
sections.body:
Along Dun Morogh's central road, Kharanos is the first true town for recruits arriving from Anvilmar. The cold and wind bite hard, but dwarven grit and gnomish ingenuity keep the settlement thriving. Its heart is a roaring public forge and the Thunderbrew Distillery, whose ale is counted among the finest in Khaz Modan and renowned across the eastern mountains.

Crafters work among weary travelers seeking warmth. Together, they make Kharanos an essential place for business in the lower peaks.

sections.title: Guarding the Lowlands
sections.body:
Behind Kharanos's cozy hearths, a military outpost guards the mountain passes. Fierce indigenous wendigo prowl the frozen caverns directly to the west, while aggressive Frostmane trolls hold Shimmer Ridge to the northwest.

Ironforge's regular forces are stretched thin across the realm. So Kharanos relies heavily on visiting adventurers and local watchmen to drive back raiding parties, cull dangerous predators, and keep the trade routes open.

faq.answer: In central Dun Morogh, Kharanos is the main settlement for dwarves and gnomes. It is a crossroads linking Coldridge Valley, Ironforge, and the outer wilderness, with trade, training services, and an inn.

faq.q: What services and facilities are in Kharanos?
faq.answer: The famous Thunderbrew Distillery is the town's inn and taproom. Kharanos also has a large public forge and class and profession trainers. Nearby, Steelgrill's Depot and other workshops provide mechanized engineering supplies.
Aggressive Frostmane troll tribes hold Shimmer Ridge to the northwest, while predatory wendigo roam the icy caves directly to the west.

angles.text: For dwarves leaving Coldridge Valley's sheltered crags, Kharanos is their first taste of the wider kingdom. Its forges steam, and the Thunderbrew clan's stout is legendary.
Refugees and tinkerers from Gnomeregan often make their homes in and around Kharanos. They work with local smiths and out of nearby depots.
